sections.title: A diverse berry genus
sections.text: Vaccinium includes low creeping shrubs, dwarf shrubs and taller shrubs or small trees. The plate shows an evergreen-looking, low blueberry-type plant with serrated leaves and blue berries; genus members vary widely in leaf habit, height and fruit colour.

sections.title: Fruits and identification
sections.text: Blueberries, bilberries, cranberries and lingonberries are familiar edible members, but edibility cannot be inferred for an unidentified wild berry from colour alone. Identify the species before eating; no medicinal or toxicity claim applies uniformly to the whole genus.
